notes.title: Patch Notes v1.04
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug that was taking a drop motion when moving down the hill. And also modified the slowness of uphill and stairs. Move more smoothly on slopes or stairs now.
[previewyoutube=7Ot0ywzK0pw;full][/previewyoutube]



2. Added a simple climbing system. If there is an obstacle ahead, press "W" + "SHIFT" to automatically attempt to cross the obstacle. Press and hold to continue over obstacles.
[previewyoutube=oiZYSEXgYlU;full][/previewyoutube]



3. The jump power has been greatly reduced. In the future, I will add a potion related to jumping power.

notes.title: Bug Hotfix v1.03
notes.content:
Updates

 Ruined Keep region has been added.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the resolution of the inventory UI and the store UI was not applied properly.

 Fixed a bug that immediately turned black when playing without selecting the character's skin color or hair color when starting a new game. The default values will take effect in the future.

 Modified the part where the night time is three times faster than the day time normally.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.02
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472542/28d621b6e23aa6cb09c6ccf2081758fec2443336.gif


Updates
[olist]
 You can rest by pressing "Rest" in the bonfire window. You can quickly skip the day and night through rest.


 The date of the in-game adventure is recorded at the top of the bonfire window.


 A new skill "Will-O-The Wisp" has been added. It follows the player and lights the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472542/146b8eb212811285fd8249a9890a25ed63e01b0f.gif



 New potions have been added. The elixir restores hp and mp at the same time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472542/bfd191c4d817ba4c634a9223388bc26e8a8ab49a.png
[/olist]

I plan to add quests and monsters using the day and night cycle system in the future. Gathering systems such as crop cultivation are also being envisioned by combining the date system and the day & night system. If you feel that the night is too dark or the light source is too bright, I would appreciate it if you could ask for feedback from the community->discussion. Also, if you request interesting ideas, bug reports, and feedback, I will immediately reflect them.


Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.01
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42472542/1df5c20b2a9b04dc67db38f1e0b80ca5331039e9.gif

Updates
[olist]
 The save function on the menu disappears, and you can save it on a bonfire throughout the map.
 The color of the drop item that comes out when you catch the boss monster has been changed to be more rare.
 Fist attacks now operate normally when unarmed.
 Running attacks are possible with "Movement + SHIFT + Left-click" in the unarmed state.
 When loading the game, the camera's rotation and zoom values load normally.
[/olist]



In addition to saving in the bonfire UI, I will add a companion management and item production system to be added later.
If there is anything else you would like, please give us your ideas in the community->discussion and we will immediately reflect them.

Thank you!

notes.title: Bug Hotfix (v1.0 - 18/6/22)
notes.content:
Currently Discovered Bugs
1. A bug in which a character falls under the terrain
2. A bug that customization system does not work properly
3. A bug where the character is constantly rising when jumping
4. A bug where Golem doesn't follow the player properly


Additional Functions
1. The "Escape!" button has been added to the in-game Menu UI. If you can't move, escape is possible through the "Escape!" button. However, be careful as it returns to the starting position.
2. When an item is discarded in the inventory UI, it is not permanently deleted and is created as a drop item around the player

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed a bug where the character would rise continuously when jumping
2. Fixed a bug that overlap equipment, hair, whiskers, etc. when loading games
3. Fixed a bug where monsters break through the building installed on the map


In addition, it would be helpful if you could find bugs or write good ideas or necessary functions in the community->discussion! I will continue to update and try to make it more like a game. Thank you.
